messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the recent token validation outage postmortem. I'm consolidating remediation tasks: 1) detect stale/expired secrets faster, 2) backfill missing audit events from the outage window, 3) restrict over-permissive staging service accounts, 4) add cache-warmup during deploys. Owners below 12.

Jordan: I can take stale/expired secret detection. Plan: add TTL sampling job that compares active secrets to rotation schedule and emits a PagerDuty if >5% drift. Also adding low-noise alerts to avoid alert fatigue. Target: 72 hours. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/2481

Sam: I'll own the audit backfill. Scope: re-ingest the 6-hour window where logs were dropped, validate event counts vs metrics, and run a parity check. Building a small backfill lambda + verification job. ETA: 4 working days. Working branch: ops/audit/rehydrate-2481

Alex: I'll do the staging SA perms tightening. Found `staging-infra-sa` bound to cluster-admin in one namespace. Will narrow to specific verbs/resources and add an automated check in infra-ci to fail if wildcard bindings exist. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: Good. Jordan, can you also add a short-term mitigation to reject tokens without JWKS lookup results (fail-closed) only for non-production to avoid user impact? We need clear rollback steps in the runbook. Link to runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident-runbooks/token-validation (please review and add your mitigation notes).

Jordan: Agreed. I'll add an opt-in feature flag for fail-closed in staging and a rate-limiter on refresh endpoints for the first 10 minutes after deploys. Draft design: /docs/auth/deploy-rate-limits.md

Maria: incident-bot logged the deploy that triggered the incident: "deploy auth-service v3.2.1 -> healthcheck failures". Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3512345678/*.log. Snapshot of relevant metric: auth.jwks.missing_count spiked to 270 in 12m.

Sam: Log snippet showing missing JWKS error we saw:
```
ERROR auth/validator: missing jwks for kid=Zk9X request_id=req-7b2a
WARN auth/caching: cache miss for jwks: Zk9X, fallback expired
```
I'll add a retry-with-backoff on JWKS fetch and a fallback-to-local-cache path + metric emission for missing-jwks.

Alex: Pushed `restrict-staging-sa.yaml` to infra-templates branch and opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/912. Tests currently failing on namespace scoping, working through it.

Priya: Let's schedule a short sync Thurs 9:30am PT to validate progress and confirm PRs. Owners: please add PR links to the GH issues before the sync. Also adding a recurring weekly checklist to security oncall for token TTL drift; will add to runbook. :calendar:

Jordan: Ack 12. I'll post an initial PR for alerts + feature flag tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Reminder set: Security remediation checkpoint in 3 days (https://calendar.redwood/3512345678-checkpoint).
